title: RAW UNREVIEWED: replenishment stops on sustained nonresponse before a different solidification endpoint
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Complete Cato88 contrasts a repeatedly renewed input whose effect eventually ceases with a later evaporation stage ending in solid product. Consider a written positive process predicate reused under sustained negative response, rather than repeated words automatically denoting repeated doses. No Voynich word is assigned.

design.production_mechanism: A compiler compresses a repeated operation into one instruction plus a persistent no-response stopping condition; a later phase keeps the intermediate referent but changes both operation and completion criterion. This is a content-bearing alternative to copying the same dose or reciting an unchanged list.
design.finite_construction: Repeatedly renew input A and act on medium B while effect R continues. When NOT R persists through a specified interval, transfer the resulting B to a second operation T until state S. A separate observable check K on B is supplied, but its formal equivalence to the first stop condition is not assumed. The historical two-day value stays a source value, never a proposed Voynich numeral.
design.unequal_consequence: The first negated predicate concerns response of the same operation/material as the preceding positive process. It is not absence of input: replenishment is expressly required. The later endpoint instead predicates a different state of the carried intermediate. A candidate that interprets both endpoints as material exhaustion, equal dose count, or one unchanged terminal property would lose this distinction. A literal repeated-event string is not predicted: a single loop instruction can describe many actions.
design.positive_structure_used: Directed composition and whole-form residuals permit a common predicate family with a scope-changing constructor; contextual transfer motivates testing both positive process and negated response with the same referent. None establishes negation, aspect, temporal duration or a process root. Broadly frequent forms cannot be assigned salt, fish or a fixed duration from this source.
design.target_status: No target candidate selected or accessed. A future prospective construction needs an already-owned complete passage with a repeated family and separately written potential endpoint/continuation. No f38v list or old recipe gloss is promoted as that construction.
design.smallest_action: During exploratory authorship of an independently selected owned passage, compare a renewed-input/no-response reading with a dose-count reading using one shared predicate and one carried referent. Record every group and profile any candidate forms before making a concrete word assignment. If only an unconstrained English paraphrase distinguishes them, retain both unbound and do not fit a decoder.
predecessors: IDEA725 already proposes command versus completion condition, and IDEA75 bounded aspect. This card adds a complete primary with renewed input, sustained absence of response, independent physical check and a distinct later endpoint; it does not claim the generic stop-condition topic is new.
IDEA421/426 dose-total and EACH distribution differ: source duration is not a dose count and renewal does not imply equal aliquots.
IDEA900 carrier lifetime and IDEA903 field inheritance remain separate; no carrier identity or inherited fields are assumed on target.
IDEA637 assay capacity remains blocked; no genuine/substitute discrimination or independent target assay graph is claimed here.
GDT1001 complete Cato133 typed writers fail all literal cases, and its1005 successor fails fixed Cennini writers. Neither is repaired or rerun.
W89 recipe pause, GDT1153 anaphoric failure and GDT1166 channel failure stay unchanged.
likely_failure: No written target distinction identifies renewed input versus diminishing stock.
A finite observed passage may fit both dose-count and endpoint readings under arbitrary roles.
Nothing requires Voynich to encode loop conditions or sustained negation.
Even a reusable construction would leave chemical identities unassigned.
design.access: Complete public source and prior reports only; no target payload, reserves, new images, contacts or implementation.
